message: Assigned your next task: implement durable agent challenges per canonical task spec v3. Start with get_task/AGENTS.md and design typed ledger records + atomic transitions. Initial policy ALL conditions; onSatisfied notify exactly once, no auto-launch. Each condition has owner, evidence, Pending/Satisfied/Blocked, issuer can reopen/cancel, persistent audit, concurrency/CAS/idempotency. Handle independently blocked task attempts with one/multiple challenge dependencies and operator-visible reason/status; explicit unblock/requeue to Ready, never silently Working; preserve task ownership/review claims. Include full client/inbox tooling and deterministic negative-space tests, Release suites and a frozen independent reviewer request when ready. No hooks/browser dependency or generic workflow engine. Work in an isolated branch/worktree, do not merge/deploy without approval. Yield at end of each turn.
